evidence.quote:
We verified the calibration against the June reference plates and it
holds across the full observing band.

observations.why: Verification is framed as a check that holds against a criterion (reference plates, full band) — a consequence-for-claim proportionality move, not hierarchy or exchange.

Bare labeled field, no relational address to any party; the label-value framing itself carries no we-ness, rank, or reciprocity signal — closest to a neutral fact-card, but too thin to call any region confidently.
